Unmistakably
Rolls-Royce
The curve of the roofline gives Phantom a feeling of
understated elegance, and suggests movement even
when the car is stationary. The power and dynamism
of the car are heightened by the optional visible chrome
exhaust, and you can also specify a brushed steel bonnet
to emphasise your Phantom’s sleek design.
The 21" wheels are the largest fitted as standard to a
production car. Standing at half the car’s height, they are
an integral part of Rolls-Royce DNA, and help to give
Phantom its commanding presence. You can choose
from 12 different wheel specifications, including different
designs, colours and finishes, to complement any
specification. Our craftspeople can also paint the wheel
centres to match the exterior of your car. Whatever
your choice, your wheels will sport self-righting centres
to ensure that the Rolls-Royce monogram is always
correctly displayed.
